01 · YOUR RANDOMLY ASSIGNED WORLD

Refreshing keeps your assigned world. Before confirmation, you may reroll up to three times; each reroll is permanent. A reset renews the allowance. Biodomes add 50 places each and generate settlers over time; they never arrive fully occupied.

02 · COMMAND CHARTER

Choose your identity

All players begin in starting galaxies. At tick 12, command redistributes players into regular galaxies and creates the clusters and galaxies required. Administrators can also shuffle manually.

The ruler and planet names identify your command. Your race selects its ships; the theme sets the interface’s appearance.
